# E0205: the version files skip a version

Versions are contiguous: each file is the next minor version of its
predecessor, or the first version of the next major. A gap would be a version
with no file.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/0.2.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a:  string
	b?: int
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0205]: 0.2.thema skips a version: after 0.0 comes 0.1
 --> 0.2.thema:1:1
  |
1 | schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = help: rename the file 0.1.thema, or add the versions between
```
